quote: I am always doing that which I cannot do, in order that I may learn how to do it.
author: Pablo Picasso

quote: Faith changes the way we calculate the value of things.
author: Unknown

quote: You either take risks or you work for someone who did.
author: Unknown

quote: Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.
author: Vincent van Gogh

quote: You do not have to see the whole staircase, just take the first step.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.

quote: We are all broken, that's how the light gets in.
author: Often attributed to Ernest Hemingway; attribution unverified

quote: When it comes to controlling human beings there is no better instrument than lies. Because, you see, humans live by beliefs. And beliefs can be manipulated.
author: Michael Ende, The Neverending Story

quote: What I've started I must finish. I've gone too far to turn back. Regardless of what may happen, I have to go forward.
author: Michael Ende, The Neverending Story

quote: There are few people whom I really love, and still fewer of whom I think well. The more I see of the world, the more am I dissatisfied with it; and every day confirms my belief of the inconsistency of all human characters, and of the little dependence that can be placed on the appearance of merit or sense.
author: Jane Austen, Pride and Prejudice

quote: If everybody minded their own business, the world would go around a great deal faster than it does.
author: Lewis Carroll, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland

quote: I know who I was when I got up this morning, but I think I must have been changed several times since then.
author: Lewis Carroll, Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
